SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q18. The LCM of the smallest two-digit composite number and the smallest composite number is:
(a) 12
(b) 4
(c) 20
(d) 44

Answer / Solution:
Smallest two-digit composite number = 10
Smallest composite number = 4
LCM(10, 4) = 20
Answer: (c) 20
